tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: Generate a short video from a text prompt. Costs $1.00 per 5-second 540x960 clip, payable by card over the Machine Payments Protocol -- no account needed. Returns immediately with a video id; rendering takes 30-90 seconds, so poll get_video_status until it is READY or ERROR.

tools.name: get_video_status
tools.description: Read the state of one video you started. Returns PENDING, PROCESSING, READY or ERROR, and the file URL once it is READY. Requires the API key that owns it.

tools.name: list_videos
tools.description: List the videos belonging to the calling API key, newest first. Requires an API key.
